lines.text: four seasons, we love them all!
Round and round the year we go,
sun and rain and leaves and snow!
Hats and mittens, cuddle up tight!
Build a snowman, slide down the hill,
Brrr, it's cold, but what a thrill!
Bunnies hop and soft winds blow!
Raindrops fall and birds sing tweet,
Baby chicks go cheep, cheep, cheep!
four seasons, we love them all!
Round and round the year we go,
sun and rain and leaves and snow!
Splash in the water, swim a lot!
Sun hats on, and off we go!
four seasons, we love them all!
Round and round the year we go,
sun and rain and leaves and snow!
four seasons, we love them all!
Round and round the year we go,
sun and rain and leaves and snow!
Swim like it's summer, splash, splash!
Float like autumn leaves, down, down!
four seasons, we love them all!
Round and round the year we go,
sun and rain and leaves and snow!
